# Renewal policy, Annex branch

A borrower may renew a circulating item **once** before the item must be
returned to a service desk for inspection. Each renewal extends the loan by
14 days from the date the renewal is processed, not from the original due date.

Renewals are refused when any of the following is true:

- another borrower has placed a hold on the title
- the borrower's account carries more than 4.00 in unpaid charges
- the item is part of the seven-day high-demand collection
- the item was borrowed through a reciprocal agreement with another system

Self-service renewal is available from the catalogue account page only; the
Annex has no telephone renewal line. Staff may not override a refused renewal;
refusals are escalated to the Main branch circulation supervisor.

Items in the reference collection do not circulate and therefore cannot be
renewed under any circumstance.
